title: Code MobX Store Review Input Contract
description: Input contract for code-mobx-store-review skill. All fields are optional — the skill collects scope from git context.

scope.description: Git diff scope to review. If omitted, defaults to full branch from merge-base to working tree.

mode.description: default = merge-base to working tree; explicit-range = from_sha..to_sha

from_sha.description: Start commit SHA for explicit-range mode

to_sha.description: End commit SHA for explicit-range mode (omit for HEAD)

job_context.description: Optional job context from job-orchestrator. Used to enrich review with project-specific knowledge.

context_path.description: Absolute path to context.md document, e.g. ~/goodea/goodai-base/jobs/<job-name>/ai/context.md
